summary: Preserved candidate PR 1565's receiver refresh, generation-safe cleanup, and locked broadcast snapshot, then corrected failure matching so a subscriber whose key concatenates multiple connection_pool CP groups is removed when its prefill node fails.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate, multi_cp_remaining=1 and stale_broadcast_calls=1, while the single-CP control had single_cp_remaining=0.
After correction, multi_cp_remaining=0, stale_broadcast_calls=0, and single_cp_remaining=0.
Five focused lifecycle tests passed, covering single- and multi-CP failure cleanup, receiver refresh, generation races, and healthy-subscriber selectivity.
All applicable formatting, lint, syntax, and registered-test policy hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are in the shared Python staging control plane; no GPU kernels or model execution were used.

remaining_limitations: The reported heterogeneous-TP topology requires at least three GPUs and multiple serving processes; only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so no full distributed serving reproduction is claimed.
No model weights were needed or used; validation is deterministic control-plane coverage rather than model semantic validation.
